title: What happens on engine crash vs. VPN interface teardown, with and without OS lockdown.
requirement: kill-switch / fail-closed design input for M5/M8.

checks.check: A. engine crashed while the TUN stays up: traffic black-holed (fail closed)

detail.stderr: curl: (28) Connection timed out after 4002 milliseconds

checks.check: A. no destination request after the crash
A uplink: nothing left the device except to the proxy endpoint(s) [('10.20.0.2', 1080)]
A uplink: no packet from the device reached a destination address directly
A uplink: no DNS (port 53) left the device
B. without OS lockdown, teardown LEAKS (expected; proves why lockdown is required)
C. with lockdown emulation, teardown is fail-closed

detail.stderr: curl: (7) Failed to connect to 10.30.0.2 port 80 after 0 ms: Couldn't connect to server

notes: B is a deliberate negative control. On Android the equivalent protection is Always-on VPN + 'Block connections without VPN' (lockdown); the app must detect and guide it.
